x.author: Madeactual
x.body: There is a third dimension: ownership. A demo has no on-call, no one who can answer why it did that at 2am, and no one who signed off on the data it touches. That is what turns cognitive debt into a business risk instead of a code smell. The estimate rule that holds up: the happy path is a small fraction of the job, and the rest is edge cases, support, and a name next to the thing. Most stalled internal software I see failed on the third one, not the first.
